Session-level bound terms, adversary wrapper and reduction bundles shared by the statements

Trusted in part. The theorems of Computational/Theorems/ use every definition in this file except fsAeadSlotSumBound and paramsV1, which are checked by Lean; the ones they use are part of what you must read to trust the result. See Computational/docs/TRUSTED_BASE.md.

Assembles the single-session security bound (uniformStartMixtureBound) for the Double Ratchet with SPQR V1 (paramsV1) from the bucket-partitioned ACD19 (Alwen, Coretti, Dodis, EUROCRYPT 2019) Fig. 8 authenticity and switch-back privacy bounds (fig8MixShortAuthV1, fig8MixShortPrivV1, fsAeadMixtureBound, fsAeadAuthMixtureCompBound; formally incomparable with the earlier per-cell bound, see DEV-LS31 and DEV-C14), the session-to-Fig. 8 refinement slack (refineConst, hiddenSaltMixtureBound, fsAeadAuthSlotSumBound; DEV-LS36), and the epoch-0 and uniform-start root-KDF PRG switches (eps0IdealUnit). Also defines the early-corruption refusal wrapper RefuseB0.refuseCorrB0 (DEV-LS33, DEV-LS34), ML-KEM encapsulation totality (Encaps1Total), and scalar-independent DH equality fibers (DhKerUniform).

Bounds are stated over a context mixture oa : ProbComp α via prefixPrgAvg, prefixPrfAvg, prefixWireAvg, and prefixAdvAvg, and evaluated on first-order ReductionDsl.CostedReduction bundles (SessionCostedReductions, sessionCostedReductionsBounded, SessionCostedReductionFamily, SessionCostedReductionFamilyBounded; see Computational/docs/REDUCTION_DSL_TUTORIAL.md).

ML-KEM encapsulation totality

def Encaps1TotalL58–62 ↗#

K.encaps1 succeeds on every 64-byte header (satisfied by libcrux ML-KEM-768, which checks only header length).

def Encaps1Total (K : LibsignalSpqrV1.MlKem) : Prop := ∀ (hdr : Bytes) (rand : List.Vector (BitVec 8) 32), hdr.length = 64 → (K.encaps1 hdr rand).isSome
namespace RefuseB0

structure RefuseStateL68–73 ↗#

Observable game-state shadow tracked by refuseCorrB0: party epochs, within-epoch indices, and in-transit (pos, ct) pairs.

structure RefuseState (C : Type) where epoch : Party → ℕ := fun _ => 0 idx : Party → ℕ := fun _ => 0 trans : List (SM.Pos × C) := []
namespace RefuseState
variable {C : Type}

def onSendL79–87 ↗#

Updates RefuseState after an accepted transmit or chall returning some c.

def onSend (rs : RefuseState C) (P : Party) (c : C) : RefuseState C := let ep' := if P.sendsIn (rs.epoch P + 1) then Function.update rs.epoch P (rs.epoch P + 1) else rs.epoch let idx₀ := if P.sendsIn (rs.epoch P + 1) then Function.update rs.idx P 0 else rs.idx let pos : SM.Pos := ⟨P, ep' P, idx₀ P + 1⟩ { epoch := ep' idx := Function.update idx₀ P (idx₀ P + 1) trans := (pos, c) :: rs.trans }

def onAcceptL89–93 ↗#

Updates RefuseState when P accepts a message at position pos.

def onAccept (rs : RefuseState C) (P : Party) (pos : SM.Pos) : RefuseState C := { rs with epoch := Function.update rs.epoch P (max (rs.epoch P) pos.epoch) trans := rs.trans.filter (fun pc => pc.1 != pos) }

def onDeliverL95–99 ↗#

Updates RefuseState after an accepted deliver-P(c).

def onDeliver [DecidableEq C] (rs : RefuseState C) (P : Party) (c : C) : RefuseState C := match rs.trans.find? (fun pc => pc.1.sender == P.other && decide (pc.2 = c)) with | some (pos, _) => rs.onAccept P pos | none => rs
end RefuseState

abbrev RefuseML103 ↗#

abbrev RefuseM (St Msg Coins C : Type) := StateT (RefuseState C) (SM.AdversaryComp St Msg Coins C)

def refuseTransmitL105–114 ↗#

def refuseTransmit {St Msg Coins C : Type} : QueryImpl ((Party × Msg × Option Coins) →ₒ Option C) (RefuseM St Msg Coins C) := fun ⟨P, m, r⟩ => do let res ← StateT.lift (SM.transmitQuery (St := St) P m r) match res with | some c => let rs ← get set (rs.onSend P c) | none => pure () return res

def refuseChallL116–125 ↗#

def refuseChall {St Msg Coins C : Type} : QueryImpl ((Party × Msg × Msg × Option Coins) →ₒ Option C) (RefuseM St Msg Coins C) := fun ⟨P, m₀, m₁, r⟩ => do let res ← StateT.lift (SM.challQuery (St := St) P m₀ m₁ r) match res with | some c => let rs ← get set (rs.onSend P c) | none => pure () return res

def refuseDeliverL127–136 ↗#

def refuseDeliver {St Msg Coins C : Type} [DecidableEq C] : QueryImpl ((Party × C) →ₒ Option (SM.RecvResult Msg)) (RefuseM St Msg Coins C) := fun ⟨P, c⟩ => do let res ← StateT.lift (SM.deliverQuery (St := St) (Coins := Coins) P c) match res with | some (.accepted _ _ _) => let rs ← get set (rs.onDeliver P c) | _ => pure () return res

def refuseInjectL138–147 ↗#

def refuseInject {St Msg Coins C : Type} : QueryImpl ((Party × C) →ₒ Option (SM.RecvResult Msg)) (RefuseM St Msg Coins C) := fun ⟨P, c⟩ => do let res ← StateT.lift (SM.injectQuery (St := St) (Coins := Coins) P c) match res with | some (.accepted t' i' _) => let rs ← get set (rs.onAccept P ⟨P.other, t', i'⟩) | _ => pure () return res

def refuseCorrL149–158 ↗#

Locally refuses corr-B when epoch .B == 0 (DEV-LS33) or epoch .A < 10 (DEV-LS34), and forwards all other corruption queries.

def refuseCorr {St Msg Coins C : Type} : QueryImpl (Party →ₒ Option St) (RefuseM St Msg Coins C) := fun P => do let rs ← get if (P == .B && (rs.epoch .B == 0)) || (P == .B && decide (rs.epoch .A < 10)) then return none else StateT.lift (SM.corrQuery (Msg := Msg) (Coins := Coins) (C := C) P)

def refuseCorrB0ImplL160–174 ↗#

def refuseCorrB0Impl {St Msg Coins C : Type} [DecidableEq C] : QueryImpl (unifSpec + SM.spec St Msg Coins C) (RefuseM St Msg Coins C) := let c : QueryImpl unifSpec (RefuseM St Msg Coins C) := fun n => StateT.lift (query (spec := unifSpec + SM.spec St Msg Coins C) (.inl n)) let i₁ : QueryImpl ((Party × Msg × Option Coins) →ₒ Option C) (RefuseM St Msg Coins C) := refuseTransmit let i₂ : QueryImpl ((Party × Msg × Msg × Option Coins) →ₒ Option C) (RefuseM St Msg Coins C) := refuseChall let i₃ : QueryImpl ((Party × C) →ₒ Option (SM.RecvResult Msg)) (RefuseM St Msg Coins C) := refuseDeliver let i₄ : QueryImpl ((Party × C) →ₒ Option (SM.RecvResult Msg)) (RefuseM St Msg Coins C) := refuseInject let i₅ : QueryImpl (Party →ₒ Option St) (RefuseM St Msg Coins C) := refuseCorr HAdd.hAdd c (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd i₁ i₂) i₃) i₄) i₅)

def refuseCorrB0L176–180 ↗#

Wraps A so that corr-B queries refused by noBobCorrInEpoch0 (DEV-LS33) or noBobCorrWhileAliceBelowEpoch10 (DEV-LS34) return none without querying the game.

def refuseCorrB0 {St Msg Coins C : Type} [DecidableEq C] (A : SM.Adversary St Msg Coins C) : SM.Adversary St Msg Coins C := (simulateQ refuseCorrB0Impl A).run' {}
end RefuseB0

Mixture averaging and SPQR V1 session bound

def prefixPrgAvgL186–188 ↗#

Averages a family of PRG distinguishers D o over a prefix distribution oa.

def prefixPrgAvg {α R : Type} (oa : ProbComp α) (D : α → PRGScheme.PRGAdversary R) : PRGScheme.PRGAdversary R := fun r => oa >>= fun o => D o r

def prefixPrfAvgL190–195 ↗#

Averages a family of PRF adversaries D o over a prefix distribution oa.

def prefixPrfAvg {α Input Tag : Type} (oa : ProbComp α) (D : α → MACScheme.PRFAdversary Input Tag) : MACScheme.PRFAdversary Input Tag := bind (m := OracleComp (unifSpec + MACScheme.prfSpec Input Tag)) (liftM oa : OracleComp (unifSpec + MACScheme.prfSpec Input Tag) α) D

def prefixWireAvgL197–202 ↗#

Averages a family of wire OT-CCA adversaries A o over a prefix distribution oa.

def prefixWireAvg {α AD H M M' T : Type} (oa : ProbComp α) (A : α → WireAEAD.WireAdversary AD H M M' T) : WireAEAD.WireAdversary AD H M M' T := bind (m := OracleComp (unifSpec + WireAEAD.wireSpec AD H M M' T)) (liftM oa : OracleComp (unifSpec + WireAEAD.wireSpec AD H M M' T) α) A

def prefixAdvAvgL204–207 ↗#

Averages a family of adversaries in an arbitrary game with coins unifSpec.

def prefixAdvAvg {ι : Type} {spec : OracleSpec ι} {α β : Type} (oa : ProbComp α) (D : α → OracleComp (unifSpec + spec) β) : OracleComp (unifSpec + spec) β := bind (m := OracleComp (unifSpec + spec)) (liftM oa : OracleComp (unifSpec + spec) α) D

structure SessionCostedReductionsL209–317 ↗#

Bundle of first-order ReductionDsl.CostedReduction programs for a single Double Ratchet + SPQR V1 session at send coins BitVec 512. Combines the SPK (spk), ACD19 Fig. 8 (fig8), and FS-AEAD (fs) reduction bundles with the session-to-Fig. 8 simulators, root-KDF PRG distinguishers, and DeliverForge authenticity reductions (challSimDF, shifted boundary cells B_cka, B_prng, B_fs, and unshifted (tL, par) buckets B_cka_u, B_prng_u, B_fs_u). ML-KEM encapsulation and decapsulation failures are excluded here and charged via MlKem.KemFailBad on the universally quantified adversary, since an existentially quantified reduction could hard-code a failing seed pair (DEV-KFF1).

CryptoVerification.E2E.fsAeadSlotSumBound

def fsAeadAuthSlotSumBoundL403–415 ↗#

Computational multi-session FS-AEAD step bound at one session: chain-PRG and salt-PRF hops on A false la, plus wire OT-CCA hops on A true la, evaluated via the two-stage direct-output reductions R.prgRedAuth and R.multiRedAuth at query fuel qR.

noncomputable def fsAeadAuthSlotSumBound {Pt : Type} [DecidableEq Pt] (C : Crypto) {codec : SignalMessageProtoCodec} {ℓ : ℕ} {encT : Pt → PublicKey} {idOf : Party → IdentityKey} (qR : ℕ) (R : FsCostedReds C codec ℓ encT idOf) (A : Bool → Bool → FsAdv Pt ℓ) : ℝ≥0∞ := 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (fsSlotCount qR), let m := FSAEAD.Thm5.slotToHybridHopIndex qR k let la := FSAEAD.Thm5.isLookaheadHop m (chainPRGTermAuthCosted C qR R (A false la) m + 2 * saltPRFTermAuthCosted C qR R (A false la) m + wireOtccaTermAuthCosted C codec ℓ qR R (A true la) m)

def fsChainPrgMixtureTermL417–425 ↗#

Mixture-averaged chain-PRG advantage at hybrid hop m and query fuel qR.

noncomputable def fsChainPrgMixtureTerm {Pt : Type} [DecidableEq Pt] {α : Type} (C : Crypto) {codec : SignalMessageProtoCodec} {ℓ : ℕ} {encT : Pt → PublicKey} (oa : ProbComp α) {idOf : α → Party → IdentityKey} (qR : ℕ) (R : ∀ o, FsCostedReds C codec ℓ encT (idOf o)) (A : α → FsAdv Pt ℓ) (m : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞ := (lChainPRG C.F (m / 2)).prgAdvantage (prefixPrgAvg oa fun o => fun mt => evalTwoStage1 ((R o).prgRedZero m) qR false (fun _ => pubToADCosted (R o) (A o)) mt)

def DhKerUniformL677–688 ↗#

Scalar-independence of DH equality fibers (Dh.dh x Q = Dh.dh x Q' ↔ Dh.dh s Q = Dh.dh s Q'), used in hop 2 to relabel the epoch-0 random function across scalars.

For clamped x-only X25519 on the prime-order subgroup Pt (0 plus the (ℓ - 1) / 2 pairs {±P} of order ℓ = 2 ^ 252 + 27742317777372353535851937790883648493), every clamped scalar c = 8m (2 ^ 251 ≤ m < 2 ^ 252) satisfies gcd(c, ℓ) = 1, so Q ↦ u(c · Q) is a bijection on Pt (δ = 2 ^ (-250)). The carrier Pt must be restricted to this prime-order subgroup under clamped scalars: nonzero E[8] or twist E'[4] torsion points are annihilated by 8m (which violates dh x Q ≠ 0), mixed-order or twist cosets separate uniform Pt challenges from honest basepoint multiples in CKA.corrGame, and unclamped scalars fail at x ≡ 0 (mod ℓ).

def DhKerUniform {Pt : Type} (Dh : DHFun (BitVec 256) Pt) : Prop := ∀ (s x : BitVec 256) (Q Q' : Pt), Dh.dh x Q = Dh.dh x Q' ↔ Dh.dh s Q = Dh.dh s Q'
